landing.title: Which documents, which office: a clear answer.
landing.lead: Ask in plain words. GovAssist shows the steps, the documents to bring and the office in your district, based on official sources.
landing.cta_note: Free. Signing up takes a minute.
landing.q1: Is this an official government service?
landing.a1: No. GovAssist is an independent student project. It doesn't accept applications or submit anything on your behalf.
landing.q2: Where do the answers come from?
landing.a2: Only from reviewed official sources (lex.uz, my.gov.uz). Every answer lists its sources.
landing.a3: Passport numbers, PINFL, phone numbers and emails are removed before anything is stored. You can delete your account at any time.
landing.a4: No. It is general information. Check the official source before an important decision.
landing.band_title: Go to the right office the first time.
landing.band_text: Ask your question and get the steps.
landing.step_1: For example: “How do I renew my passport?”
landing.step_2: Steps, documents to bring, fee and time, with sources.
landing.step_3: The office in your district: address, hours and map.
landing.ask_label: Type your question. After you sign up, the answer starts right away
landing.problem_title: The wrong office costs you a day
landing.problem_lead: For a public service it is often unclear which office to go to and what to bring.
landing.p1: You wait in line, then learn the service is handled somewhere else.
landing.p2: One missing paper means a second trip.
landing.p3: You can't tell when the advice in forums and chats was written.
landing.problem_answer: GovAssist shows it all in one place, before you go.
landing.compare_lead: Both answer questions. The difference is what the answer is based on, and where it sends you next.
landing.c1_bot: Answers from memory or web pages
landing.c1_us: Only official documents (lex.uz, my.gov.uz), every step cited
landing.c2_us: The exact office in your district: address, hours, map
landing.c4_bot: Weak in Uzbek, ignores the script
landing.c5_bot: No idea how fresh its information is
landing.c5_us: Shows the date every source was fetched
landing.services_lead: Pick a service and the question is ready. After you sign up, you get the answer right away.

about.title: About GovAssist
about.what: GovAssist is an assistant that answers questions about public services and laws. It is built as part of an MSc thesis at ITPU.
about.how_1: Answers come only from reviewed sources (lex.uz, my.gov.uz and others). There is no live web search.
about.how_2: Each fact shows a source number. Tap it to open the original page.
about.how_3: Office addresses and hours come from our database; the AI never writes them. Every card shows the date of the data.
about.how_4: This is not legal advice. Before an important decision, check the official source or ask a professional.
about.privacy_1: We store your email, your chosen area and your chats.
about.privacy_2: Passport numbers, PINFL, phone numbers and emails are removed before anything is stored, processed or logged.
about.privacy_3: To write the answer, your question is sent to Google Gemini without personal data.
about.privacy_4: You can delete your account at any time in Settings.
